_note: Sale events — the single source of truth for the whole site. Each event has an EXACT `raised` total; the nested `supported[]` amounts are estimates tuned to sum to it. `kind` is exactly 'candle-sale' or 'special-event'. Candle-sale events also carry `candles` and `participants`. Every aggregate (totals, growth, chart heights, candle math, grand total) is computed in metrics.js — never hardcode it. Site config (pricePerCandle, candleConstants, tightestRace) lives in site.json.

supported.blurb: Delivers humanitarian aid and medical supplies to Ukrainians affected by the war.

supported.name: Agate Housing + Services
supported.blurb: Works to prevent and end homelessness through shelter, housing, and food programs.

supported.name: Save the Snakes
supported.blurb: Protects snake populations and eases human–snake conflict through conservation and education.

supported.name: Free Guitars 4 Kids
supported.blurb: Puts guitars and music lessons into the hands of kids who want to play.

supported.name: Oceanites
supported.blurb: Studies Antarctic penguins and ecosystems to track the health of a warming planet.
supported.reason: Oceanites is a non-profit that helps the entire arctic peninsula, though penguins are their first priority. They are trying to help with the warming arctic.

supported.name: Food Recovery Network
supported.blurb: Rescues surplus food from 200+ college campuses to fight waste and feed communities.
supported.reason: Food Recovery Network started with college students who saw perfectly good cafeteria food being thrown away and decided to do something about it. Volunteers like me pack up extras and send them to community food shelves.

supported.name: Heart to Care Tanzania
supported.blurb: Builds and grows a school in a small Tanzanian village, founded by a Twin Cities woman.
supported.reason: Heart to Care was founded by a woman from the Twin Cities after a chance meeting in Tanzania led her to help start a school in a small village. She works tirelessly to grow the school and support everyone involved.

supported.name: American Prairie
supported.blurb: Building one of the largest nature reserves in America across the Montana prairie.
supported.reason: I grew up on the prairie and have always been fascinated by bison and the strength of these ecosystems. I love how American Prairie is helping a thriving prairie ecosystem grow.

events.name: 2024 Candle Sale
events.takeaway: Opening part of the sale to the public at the holiday boutique brought a big jump and introduced the candles to a wider community.

posts.title: Things 4 Good Four Year Impact
posts.description: A four-year impact recap with charts and a look at the growing community behind the fundraiser.

supported.name: SynGAP Research Fund
supported.blurb: Funds research toward treatments and a cure for SYNGAP1-related disorders.
supported.reason: I first learned about SYNGAP1 from UFDTech, one of my favorite YouTubers, whose son lives with this rare genetic disorder and has about 100 seizures a day. The fund supports research and families facing it.

supported.name: Water to Thrive
supported.blurb: Builds wells bringing clean, safe water to communities across sub-Saharan Africa.
supported.reason: A cool glass of water is something I take for granted, while many people in sub-Saharan Africa still walk hours for it. Water to Thrive builds wells that can change health, school, and work for years.

supported.name: Sprint to Cité Soleil
supported.blurb: Empowers kids in Cité Soleil, Haiti through basketball, mentorship, and a meal.
supported.reason: Sprint to Cité Soleil empowers kids in Haiti through basketball, mentorship, and a meal. It was founded by a teenager in our neighborhood and his friend, and employs local coaches and cooks.

supported.name: World Central Kitchen
supported.blurb: Serves fresh meals to communities in the wake of disasters worldwide.
supported.reason: I first noticed World Central Kitchen when they were bringing meals to people in Ukraine. Since then I have seen them respond in Palestine, after hurricanes in the US, and wherever fresh meals are urgently needed.

supported.name: Mt. Olivet Lutheran Church
supported.blurb: Mt. Olivet is a church in our neighborhood that has a strong commitment to racial justice and equity, and they have a lot of programs that support people in need in our community and around the world.
supported.reason: As a participant in the Mt. Olivet Winter Market we contributed 10% of all sales that occurred at the market.

events.name: 2025 Candle Sale
events.takeaway: Our biggest year yet, with the tightest split between causes and the clearest proof that this has become a community tradition.

posts.description: The 2025 results post with the final allocation, the four supported organizations, and the tightest distribution yet.

posts.description: The five-year view of the fundraiser: charts, cumulative impact, and the community tradition taking shape.

supported.name: Sandy Hook Promise
supported.blurb: Works every day to protect children from gun violence — the leading cause of death for kids in America.
supported.reason: I was driving to work when first responders raced toward Annunciation, less than a mile from our home. It was horrible, and none of this should happen. Sandy Hook Promise works every day to protect kids from gun violence.

supported.name: The Food Group
supported.blurb: Gets local, healthy food to people in need and runs a sustainable teaching farm.
supported.reason: The Food Group gets low-cost, local, healthy food to food shelves and runs an organic teaching farm. I chose them because they address food insecurity while helping the next generation of farmers.

supported.name: Border Angels
supported.blurb: Supports migrants and refugees along the US–Mexico border with water, bond aid, and supplies.
supported.reason: Centered around love, Border Angels helps migrants and refugees along the US-Mexico border with water drops in dangerous desert crossings, bond assistance, shelter supplies, and family support.

supported.name: Animal Welfare Institute
supported.blurb: Works to end human-caused suffering for animals everywhere — from labs to farms.
supported.reason: Animal Welfare Institute works to end human-caused suffering for animals, from labs to farms. I picked them because animals should not suffer because of people, and we have a responsibility to prevent unnecessary harm.

events.name: Holiday Market
events.note: A friend hosted a holiday market in December and sold our candles.

supported.name: Second Harvest Heartland
supported.blurb: One of the nation’s largest hunger-relief organizations, getting nutritious food to neighbors across Minnesota and beyond.
